title: Full DFT calculations for Al, Li, and Al3Li
action: Perform self‑consistent DFT (or LMTO) calculations for fcc Al, bcc Li, and L12 Al3Li using the Perdew–Zunger LDA exchange‑correlation functional. For each system, compute total energies at several volumes around the approximate equilibrium to generate total‑energy vs. volume data sets.
description: Runs the reference calculations that produce the raw total energies required for all subsequent property and charge analyses. The evidence file may contain the computed energy‑volume points.

title: DFT calculation for Al3Li without d‑states
action: Repeat the self‑consistent calculation for L12 Al3Li, but exclude the d‑orbital valence states on the Li atoms from the basis set. Keep all other settings identical. Generate a second total‑energy vs. volume data set.
description: Isolates the effect of Li d‑electrons. The output is required to obtain the overestimated lattice parameter and bulk modulus reported in the paper.

title: Extract elastic and structural properties (scored)
action: From the energy‑volume data generated in steps 1 and 2, fit each set to a Birch–Murnaghan equation of state to determine the equilibrium lattice parameter a₀ and bulk modulus B for pure Al, pure Li, Al3Li (full basis), and Al3Li (no d‑states). Compute the lattice mismatch Δa/a between Al3Li and Al, and the enthalpy of formation of Al3Li. Write all results to elastic_properties.json.
description: Aggregates the key geometric and mechanical properties. The no‑d values must be derived from the separate no‑d calculation; the file thus forces the execution of both process steps.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: Al (object with a0 in Å, B in GPa), Li (a0, B), Al3Li (a0, B), mismatch (dimensionless), enthalpy_formation (Ry/atom), Al3Li_no_d (a0, B). Example skeleton: {"Al":{"a0": <float>, "B": <float>}, "Li": {"a0": ..., "B": ...}, "Al3Li": {"a0": ..., "B": ...}, "mismatch": <float>, "enthalpy_formation": <float>, "Al3Li_no_d": {"a0": ..., "B": ...}}

title: Extract valence electron occupations (scored)
action: From the self‑consistent charge density of the full Al3Li calculation, integrate the electron counts inside the Li and Al atomic (Wigner–Seitz) spheres, decomposed into s, p, d components. Compute reference occupations for pure Al and pure Li. Write a CSV table.
description: CSV table of valence electron occupations per atomic sphere. Columns: system, sphere, s, p, d. Rows must include Li and Al spheres for Al3Li, and may include rows for pure Al and pure Li.
output_schema:
CSV with header: system,sphere,s,p,d. Rows: e.g., Al3Li,Li,,

, and Al3Li,Al,,

,. Optional rows: Al,Al,,

, and Li,Li,,

,.
